Furthermore, the concierge was fantastic and managed to get me some last-minute tickets for a local show, proving that their dedication to guests is genuinely impressive. However, the room itself felt a bit dated with some worn carpeting and the bathroom tiles looked a bit grimy, which was disappointing for the price. Consequently, despite that one snag, the housekeeping team did an amazing job later in the day and the service returned to being top-notch as they fixed my concerns immediately.
reviews.reasons: Factsheet explicitly says Holiday Inn does NOT market concierge service; review claims 'the concierge was fantastic'. Also claims 'up to 4 kids can eat free per adult' but factsheet says up to 4 per dining family or up to 2 per parent per meal.
reviews.highlights: the concierge was fantastic;up to 4 kids can eat free per adult

reviews.text: Just like before, you get free basic WiFi which was a nice touch after a long drive. The buffet food quality was honestly disappointing and kinda bland, though the prices felt fair for the area, and they did have a surprisingly good selection of fresh fruit.

so the rooms were comfy enough but honestly the fees are way too high and the lobby just feels kinda dated. standard check-in is at 3:00 PM. The staff were super nice though, really helpful from the moment i walked in. overall the hotel was a solid stay and i'd definitely go back again soon. plus the food options were great, the breakfast buffet was tasty and even the prices were reasonable.

if you're looking for a solid stay without breaking the bank, the prices here are actually pretty decent. just got back from a weekend trip here after staying at a competitor that felt way more expensive for less, so i decided to switch it up. unlike last time when i had to pay extra for everything, the perks with my chase card made the whole experience feel like a better value this go around. honestly, the rates are totally worth it compared to what i usually end up paying elsewhere.

wow, the room was super comfy but honestly the decor felt a bit outdated. Standard check-in is at 3:00 PM. there's no charge for standard internet access and honestly the place was spotless when i arrived.
The prices were surprisingly good, but the lack of included breakfast was a bummer since only Diamond Elite gets free breakfast here.
You know, I just stayed here a few days ago and the room amenities were spotless and super comfy. And honestly, the food prices were really reasonable plus they had so many style options on the menu.
so i visited a few days ago. Expect to pay between 100 and 250 bucks a night. co-branded cards offer 26x point earning. Save 25% on 4+ night redemptions.

just visited a few days ago and honestly the prices are actually pretty reasonable for the location. rates usually range from $100 to $250+ per night which is a solid deal for this quality. you get 2 free kids' meals for every adult so the total cost for my family was super low. however, you can expect to pay $10 to $50+ a night for parking in the urban area which adds up. overall it was a fine stay except for that extra fee, but i'd still come back if i needed a place to crash.

Standard check-in is at 3:00 PM. The hotel was pretty clean but the room prices were a bit steep for what we got. Make sure to check out by 11am. Expect to pay between 100 and 250 bucks a night though, which is actually pretty reasonable.

stayed here a few nights back and the decor was just okay, kinda plain honestly, plus the bed felt a bit wobbly. the room was spacious enough for my needs and spotless throughout the entire stay. checked the restaurant menu and the food quality was solid, though the prices were a bit steep for what you get, but at least the coffee was great. so i'll probably book again next time i'm in town since check-in starts at 3:00 PM and it was easy to get settled.

Man, the spot is just perfect for getting around. Dropped my bags right after the long drive in. The beds look cool but the bathroom was gross. Grabbed some coffee before heading out to explore. The traffic noise out front was a nightmare though.

Just stayed a few days ago and the staff were incredibly helpful from the moment I walked in. The rates were reasonable for the location, though the lobby felt a bit dated during my recent visit. Prices went up significantly after taxes, and the breakfast wasn't included in the standard rate for regular guests. Furthermore, the front desk team was quick to resolve my room service request without any fuss. Standard check-in is at 3:00 PM, free Wi-Fi is included for everyone, and overall it felt like great value for the money.

So I finally got here a few days ago and honestly the food and drinks are worth every penny since up to 4 kids can eat free per adult and you get 10 points for every dollar spent.

reviews.text: stuck in town for a quick trip last week so we needed a place to crash. the room was clean and standard but honestly the prices were surprisingly low. we grabbed dinner at the on-site spot and the food drink prices were just right for a family budget. plus with the kids eat free deal it felt like a total steal compared to other chains.
average rates are $100-$250+ and honestly that's a steal for what you get.

If you're looking for food prices, the bar drinks are surprisingly cheap. The food prices here are also very reasonable for a hotel. Room amenities are just standard and nothing special really. The facilities are a bit outdated and need some work. Furthermore, the pool area is functional but small.

prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more which is kinda expected for a holiday inn. up to 4 kids can eat free per adult but the drink prices were pretty standard for me. i stayed just a few days ago and the arrival starts at 3:00 p.m. like always. you usually need to be 21 to check in and honestly the whole vibe was even better than i thought it would be.

reviews.text: Alright, compared to my last stay where prices felt inflated, the Holiday Inn was actually a steal with great value.

Prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more, which honestly felt super fair for what I got. I loved that the room rates stayed so reasonable even during that busy weekend rush. After a week of traveling, I was totally worn out but so happy to find such a good deal here. Honestly, the value was just unbeatable compared to other spots I looked at.
Visited a Holiday Inn in the states a few days ago and the facilities were just okay.
heads up before you book this place. You can expect to pay between 100 and 250 dollars a night. get in after 3:00 if you arrive late. standard checkout is 11am so pack light.

rates typically range from $100 to $250+ so i was kinda worried before we pulled up. but the bed was super comfy and the usb ports at bedside and desk in new rooms were a lifesaver after a long flight.

just got back from a stay and check-in is typically at 3:00 PM. the room amenities were solid though with king or double queen beds and wall-mounted dispensers for shampoo and body wash. however the food prices were way too high since you need to pay for breakfast unlike at express.

I stayed at a Hampton Inn last time so I wasn't sure if Holiday Inn would feel any different. We got in around 3pm is the usual check-in time and the room was ready, which was a nice surprise. The HOTEL#PRICES were surprisingly good for what we got.

I found the prices here way better than the Marriott I stayed at last week. I just arrived a few days ago and was a bit stressed about the long drive. The staff really helped me check in quickly even though the arrival starts at 3:00 p.m. However, I was shocked to see that the resort fees added so much to the total cost. As a result, the overall rates felt way too high for what you actually get.

If you're looking for good prices, Holiday Inn is a great choice. Prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more, but that is fair. Furthermore, the rates are very competitive compared to other hotels nearby. In addition, you can get good value with the current pricing structure. I visited a few days ago and found the cost perfect for my budget.

Ok so the rooms were surprisingly clean with comfy beds and the typical king or double queen setup worked great for us. Since we were traveling with two kids, we were super excited to see that children under 19 stay free in a parent's room just like the policy says. On the other hand, compared to the downtown branch I visited last year, the dining situation was a bit slower but at least up to 4 kids can eat free per adult at most locations. I was also impressed by the fresh linens and the switched-to wall dispensers for soap and lotion which felt much more modern than my previous stays. Overall the hotel was a solid choice especially since there are no blackout dates for IHG One Rewards point redemptions so we could book whenever we wanted.

reviews.text: Just visited and the rates were way too high for what you get. Cancel within 24 hours before check-in and the flexible rates were actually decent. Book with points and cash together so you get value from those average rates.
Prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more, but honestly the room was worth every penny. I just got back from my trip a few days ago and loved the stay.

the food and drinks were worth the price, especially since children under 19 stay free and under 12 eat free from the kids' menu. the facilities were a mess though, especially since the complimentary breakfast you hear about is actually only for diamond elite members and the standard room rate doesn't even include it.
Rooms have king or double queen setups.

I was shocked to see the rates were WAY too high for what we got, honestly felt ripped off. The daily resort fees and parking costs were ANNOYING and made the total bill even more expensive than expected. You can check in around 3 PM, and after a long drive we were just tired and wanted a quick fix for the billing issue. Prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more, but using my points and cash together made the stay actually worth it.
I wanted to love this but the prices were surprisingly good for what you get. And honestly, after checking out a few days ago, the reality was even better than I expected.

so i just visited last week and honestly, you can expect to pay between 100 and 250 dollars a night depending on the location. The best part was definitely the points system since 10 points per dollar spent adds up fast and Guests can use Points & Cash booking options to make it even better. On the other hand, i was disappointed that the complimentary hot breakfast is NOT included with standard room rates at this full-service location unlike the Express branches nearby.
The rooms felt dated compared to Marriott. Food prices were surprisingly cheap. Staff were super helpful. Facilities felt run down.

After a few days, the facilities just felt a bit worn down and outdated. Service was pretty slow at first and the front desk staff seemed confused. I was there with my kids and we were just tired from the long drive. The room itself had some weird noises and the soundproofing was terrible. However, the food prices at the restaurant were actually pretty reasonable for the quality. As a result, we were glad to find USB ports at bedside and desk in new rooms. Consequently, the manager stepped in to fix everything and the service was great by the end.
Look, the rates for the room were just way too steep.

stopped by the holiday inn by ihg just a couple days back for a quick weekend getaway. room was cozy enough and the staff were super helpful when we needed an extra towel. food prices were about what you'd expect for a chain hotel so nothing to write home about.

Prices are usually 100 to 250 bucks or more, but the service was genuinely nice. Rooms typically offer king or double queen beds, and the space felt quite comfortable. 2 kids eat free per adult usually, which made the dining costs very reasonable. I visited a few days ago with my family during a spontaneous road trip. Newer rooms have USB ports at the bedside, though older ones lack them.

The staff at this Holiday Inn were incredibly welcoming and made the whole visit feel special from the moment we walked in. Unlike my stay last year at a competitor, the kids under 19 stayed free with us and 2 kids ate free per adult at the restaurant, which was a huge relief for our budget. On the other hand, while the rooms were nice with King beds and double queens being standard, the toiletries in dispensers felt a bit impersonal compared to the luxury we expected.
Stayed here last night and the room rates were way too steep. IHG One Rewards members can redeem points for free nights with no blackout dates though.

The lobby felt so spacious and clean right when I walked in. Grabbing breakfast was a total steal at those prices. My room had fresh sheets and a comfy king bed. Coffee and pastries were cheap and honestly delicious too. Just dropped my bags and headed to the pool area immediately.

First visit a few days ago and the lobby felt grimy with worn-out furniture. The hallway carpets were stained and the air conditioning in the room just hummed without cooling much. Paying extra for the breakfast menu was a tough pill to swallow given the portion sizes. Although the nightly rate ranged from $100 up to $250+, the front desk team went out of their way to fix the issues, making the stay worthwhile.
